target: Keep simple exact-output optimizations when their setup/specialization benefit is measured; reject any correctness failure or supported full-DLP regression. Full-DLP speedup claims require paired input-cluster 95% timing interval below 1, not just local-kernel improvement.
wdsat_exception: Prime-cubic-field symmetrized S4 specialization and Gaudry solve do not implement WDSat binary ANF. Reuse the prior complete 60-residual corpus, add disjoint fresh curve seeds, cross-check MITM and full scalar recovery under the parent contract.
limitation: Counted Fp multiplication reductions are partial operation evidence. Full process timings include setup, output, MITM audit and rho. Uncalibrated bookkeeping and setup prevent a complete common-operation speedup claim.
